about: Fixed data for _includes/variable-mortgages-chart.html, from the ECB Data Portal. Not updated automatically: see "Variable-rate mortgage chart" in README.md to redo it.
definition: New business loans to households for house purchase with a floating rate or an initial rate fixed for up to 1 year, as a percentage of all new business loans to households for house purchase (ECB MFI interest rate statistics)
method: The average of the monthly shares over the 12 months; a country with months the ECB does not publish is averaged over the months it has
short_note: Bulgaria joined the euro in January 2026. For the others, the ECB doesn’t publish the missing months.
